name: Named Collective
notes: BORDERLINE. It sells hoodies, sweatpants and tracksuit sets, but its own positioning ('Independent fashion label'; About: 'a London-based independent collective') never says streetwear, and neither did the fetched hoodies page. A WebSearch summary claimed some category pages call pieces streetwear, but that wasn't fetched. Off_category under this run's rule; a human may override.
GBP store (hoodies £90–£125); us.namedcollective.com 301-redirects to the main site. No USD prices, so none are stored.
Returns: 14 days for US orders; the page says 'UK orders', which looks like a typo. International orders get 21 days. Size charts are images, so no sizes were read.
2026-10-29 re-check for C = jeans: stays off_category. /collections/denim serves 1 product (sweatpants) and /collections/jeans serves none.
